ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels across central lobe regions versus 30% low-intensity black pixels localized on trailing edges and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white contiguous zones on both lobes. Thick low-intensity black bands along trailing edges. Small circular black pixel clusters at upper-left and upper-right quadrants. A dark vertical line defines the central fluke split.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with an estimated interior angle of 50 degrees; depth occupies roughly 15% of the total vertical bounding box of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary along trailing edges with high-frequency pixel variations; amplitude of peaks varies between 5-15 pixels from the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Mathematical concave curve fitting the trailing edges from notch to tips; terminal tips show sharp upward and outward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels (barnacles) on distal tips. Isolated circular marks present on interior white surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel tracks (rake marks) observed; particularly a vertical set on the inner right lobe and intersecting diagonal lines on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on terminal tips; multiple parallel linear rake marks on the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Yellow-tinted pigment cluster observed in the central-left lobe region.
